patterns.note: A high-contrast color scheme uses a vibrant purple for the main content area against a dark background for the header and footer, making the error message pop.
The page employs a clear three-section vertical layout: a dark header, a full-bleed vibrant main content area, and a dark multi-column footer.
Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, establishing a clear visual hierarchy for the error message.
The page is entirely static; no scroll-triggered animations or reveals are present, maintaining a consistent visual state regardless of scroll depth.
The main content section is visually distinct with its bright background and centered content, immediately drawing attention to the error message and illustration.

technique_notes: The primary content area utilizes a full-bleed, high-saturation background color to create a strong visual anchor for the page's core message.
The header and footer sections are visually separated from the main content by using a contrasting dark background, providing clear structural boundaries.
The page design is static, relying on a fixed layout and content presentation without any scroll-triggered motion or dynamic element reveals.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body text) with a clear hierarchy, supported by smaller, legible body text and even smaller utility links in the footer.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are used for interactive elements like buttons, while the overall page structure maintains sharp edges.
design_tokens.spacing: A balanced density in the main content area, with ample whitespace around the central message and illustration, contrasting with a denser, multi-column layout in the footer.

standout: The distinctive use of a playful, whimsical illustration of a keyboard with flowers on an error page, combined with a bold, high-contrast purple background, transforms a potentially frustrating experience into a more engaging and on-brand moment.
